title: Peruvian Stir Fry with Parmigiano Reggiano
description: A quick and flavorful Peruvian-inspired stir fry featuring stir-fried vegetables and topped with crumbled Parmigiano Reggiano cheese.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the onion and red bell pepper and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the zucchini and tomato and stir-fry for an additional 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
5. Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
6. Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter.
7. Sprinkle the crumbled Parmigiano Reggiano cheese over the top of the rice mixture.
